commands: UPDATE_LOCAL_SNAPSHOTS=1 cargo test -p supabricks-local --test application_api mcp
isolation: UID 1001 Docker; no external networking; read-only qualified engine and debug binary; fixture-owned temporary state
limitations: Linux focused validation only; macOS implementation and portable/native tests await GitHub CI.
Process-tree snapshots are non-atomic. Churn and ambiguous ownership produce gaps. Detached/reparented descendants and CPU not rolled up by the OS are outside the scope.
RSS sum can count shared pages repeatedly; effective resource limits are not discovered or enforced.
No latency histograms, governed monitoring or product charts.
No local engine rebuild or full CI run.
